newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: German tourist dies in S.Africa hang-gliding fall.
newsitem.headline: German tourist dies in S.Africa hang-gliding fall.

text.p: A German tourist was killed in South Africa on Friday after he fell from his hang-glider, police said on Monday.
State radio said Karl Ernst Pakrant, 48, died at the scene of the fall after suffering back and head injuries.
A police spokesman said the tourist's body was recovered in the Swartberg Mountains in the arid Oudtshoorn region in misty weather conditions on Friday night.
His wife, who had been touring South Africa with him, had already returned to Germany and was making arrangements for his body to be flown back for burial, the spokesman said.
